decisions.reason: It builds on the established spraying business, likely uses existing capabilities, and with no clear failure signal management would be inclined to continue rather than write off a recent launch.
As a close extension of the core offer that already received its own webpage, it reflects visible commitment and is likely to be retained unless results turn clearly and persistently negative.
Because it is a full product line with several models built on the existing business, the firm has likely invested materially and will tend to persist with it.

Although somewhat more adjacent than the pump products, it was given its own page and fits the firm’s move toward future-oriented system solutions, so management is still more likely to keep it than drop it.
